claim.claim-text: 1. An integrated system for recycling waste material including waste paper comprising:
2. The system of claim 1, wherein the screening device comprises a plurality of openings having an average area from about 20 to about 400 mm<2>.
3. The system of claim 1, wherein the system is co-located on-site at a pulp and paper mill.
4. The system of claim 3, wherein the water supply device is integrated with a water treatment facility at the pulp and paper mill.
5. The system of claim 1, further comprising one or more separators for separating the substantially re-pulped waste paper from a majority of any non-cellulosic solids in the first portion.
6. The system of claim 5, wherein the one or more separators comprise one or more of a density separator or a size separator.
7. The system of claim 5, wherein the one or more separators comprise a second trommel, a course screen, a fine screen, or a combination thereof.
8. The system of claim 5, wherein the one or more separators comprise a high density cleaner.
9. The system of claim 5, wherein the one or more separators comprise a high density cleaner, a course screen, and a fine screen in series with one another.
10. The system of claim 5, further comprising a dewatering device for removing at least a portion of solubilized organics and liquids from the separated substantially re-pulped waste paper.
11. The system of claim 10, wherein the dewatering device comprises a screw press, a filter press, or a combination thereof.

12. The system of claim 10, further comprising an anaerobic digester system configured for receiving at least a portion of liquids and solubilized organics separated from the substantially re-pulped waste paper.
13. The system of claim 12, further comprising a boiler for converting biogas produced by the anaerobic digester system into energy for use in the system and/or the pulp and paper mill.

14. The system of claim 5, further comprising a reactor system for converting at least a portion of the separated substantially re-pulped waste paper to one or more furaldehydes, organic acids, organic acid degradation products, or combinations thereof.

15. The system of claim 14, wherein the reactor system comprises a first reactor for hydrolyzing cellulose present in the substantially re-pulped waste paper to glucose, and a second reactor for converting the glucose to one or more furaldehydes, organic acids, organic acid degradation products, or combinations thereof.

16. The system of claim 5, further comprising one or more secondary separators to separate substantially fiber-free recoverable/recyclable plastics and metals in the second portion, the one or more secondary separators being selected from the group consisting of a density separator, an optical separator, and a metal separator.

17. The system of claim 16, wherein the one or more secondary separators comprise a metal separator comprising a magnet to separate ferrous metals and an eddy current to separate aluminum and non-ferrous metals.

18. The system of claim 16, wherein the one or more secondary separators comprise an optical separator configured to recover polyethylene terephthalate (PET), polyethylene, polypropylene, polyvinyl chloride, polystyrene, or combinations thereof.
19. The system of claim 18, further comprising a means for converting the recovered PET into one or more of PET flakes or PET film.
20. The system of claim 16, further comprising a fuel cube system for manufacture of refuse derived fuel comprising the substantially fiber-free recoverable/recyclable plastics.

21. The system of claim 20, wherein the fuel cube system comprises a combination of one or more of a shredder, a compressor, and/or a pelletizer configured to convert the substantially fiber-free recoverable/recyclable plastics into a refuse derived fuel.
22. The system of claim 21, further comprising a dewatering device for removing at least a portion of any liquids from the substantially fiber-free recoverable/recyclable plastics.
23. The system of claim 22, wherein the dewatering device comprises a screw press, a filter press, or a combination thereof.
24. The system of claim 20, further comprising a boiler for converting the refuse derived fuel produced by the fuel cube system into energy for use in the system and/or the pulp and paper mill.
25. The system of claim 16, further comprising a pyrolyzer for converting substantially fiber-free recoverable/recyclable plastics to one or more products suitable for use as a fuel.
